state.objective: Resolve two remaining below-0.95 confidence claims using new concrete evidence. Do not claim functionality that has not been tested.
facts: The 225 working design contains 58 target accounts classified RETAIN because they represent distinct natural-account natures under the completed domain reviews.
Reducing the entire design to 30 would require eliminating or merging at least 28 of those 58 RETAIN accounts before considering any conditional or unresolved accounts.
No completed review supports merging those 58 retained natures into 30 or fewer accounts.

The current family register identifies which dimension types are required for each mapping but does not yet contain a tested row-level set of concrete dimension values for every possible new transaction.
Therefore unique reverse mapping of every future transaction has not been operationally proven.

A future implementation can enforce a unique key over target_account_id plus the required dimension values and effective date, then test representative and boundary transactions against expected legacy codes.

thirty_conflict_with_retain.instructions: Is a 30-account target currently unsupported when 58 distinct natural-account targets are already classified RETAIN and no evidence supports merging them?

criteria.yes: Thirty conflicts with the retained-nature decisions and would require unsupported mergers.
criteria.no: Thirty is supported without changing any retained nature.

thirty_go_live.instructions: Should a 30-account configuration be rejected for go-live under the current evidence?

criteria.yes: Use the evidence-aware working design instead.

reverse_mapping_current.instructions: Has unique reverse mapping for every future transaction been proven by the current register?

criteria.no: Required dimension types are documented, but concrete keys and transaction tests are not yet complete.
criteria.yes: Dimension labels alone prove operational uniqueness.

reverse_mapping_gate.instructions: What must happen before unique reverse mapping can be relied upon?

criteria.implement_test: Define concrete dimension values, enforce uniqueness/effective dates, and pass transaction-level mapping tests without ambiguous or missing matches.
criteria.assume: Assume uniqueness from the proposed architecture.

criteria.historical_yes_future_conditional: Original historical legacy reports remain available; reverse mapping of new transactions is conditional on implementing and passing the uniqueness gate.
criteria.all_proven: Both historical and future reverse mapping are already fully proven.
